# Fine-tuning results

<!-- generated by research/finetune/report.ts: do not edit by hand -->

Every run fine-tunes **Qwen3.5-0.8B** with Unsloth's `FastDecisionModel` (LoRA r 16, lr 2e-4, 2 epochs, 2,048 tokens) unless its name says otherwise, then is scored on the **same 200 Opus gold test states** from held-out towns (seeds 151–160). "Own test" is accuracy against the teacher's labels on the test towns: how well the student imitates.

## Student vs teacher

A student model is capped by its teacher. Each pair of bars shows the trained model's agreement with the gold labels (blue) next to its teacher's own agreement on the same states (orange).

## All runs

| Run | Teacher | Own test: acc · record · ECE | Gold move | Gold spend (±1) | Gold invest share | Train min | VRAM |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| e01-heuristic-0.8b | heuristic | 77.6% · 43% · 0.022 | **60%** (n=120) | 28% (70%) | 39% | 22.6 | 2.54 GB |
| e02-d3hard-0.8b | d3 | 83.1% · 61% · 0.016 | **61%** (n=160) | 40% (69%) | 24% | 21.7 | 2.54 GB |
| e03-d3soft-0.8b | d3 (soft) | 85.0% · 64% · 0.048 | – | – | – | 21.7 | 2.54 GB |
| e04-haiku-0.8b | haiku | 78.6% · 49% · 0.103 | **95%** (n=200) | 63% (100%) | 78% | 15.5 | 2.55 GB |
| e05-haikufull-0.8b | haiku | 78.4% · 47% · 0.124 | **96%** (n=200) | 60% (98%) | 80% | 21.3 | 2.54 GB |

**Reading the columns.** *Acc* is per question; *record* means every question in a decision was right; *ECE* (expected calibration error) is the gap between how confident the model is and how often it's right, after temperature calibration. *Gold spend* is exact level, with within one level in brackets: exact spend tops out near 60% for any rule (see the lab notebook, row 25).
